newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka Stock Exchange dismisses chairman after report.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka Stock Exchange dismisses chairman after report.

text.p: The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE)'s governing council dismissed DSE Chairman Imtiyaz Husain on Sunday and replaced him with council member Abdul Huq Howlader, DSE officials said.
They said Husain was removed from the post in connection with a recent scandal over share price manipulation.

His dismissal follows the resignation earlier this week of five of the nine elected members of the council to back their demand for immediate reforms of the stock exchange following an official inquiry which accused dozens of share dealers and company executives of manipulating share prices.

Husain, who was criticised by the inquiry, had refused to step down from his post and described the inquiry's report as baseless and motivated. The DSE members who resigned this week demanded early DSE elections to pave the way for reforms based on the inquiry report, which said fraudulent activities had led to huge losses for investors.
